subject: Helion Systems: supplier portal stuck on security question loop
body:
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@helionsys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: support@helionsys.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Can't finish supplier setup — keeps asking security question after SSO

Hi Diego,

We're walking through the supplier setup link you sent but after the SSO redirect (Coupa) the portal keeps presenting the "Confirm your account" security question screen. We answer the question, hit Continue, and it redirects back to the same question. Tried in Chrome and Safari, incognito and normal. Clearing cookies helped once but it came back after re-trying the link.

I attached a screenshot (helion_sso_screenshot.png) and a small debug dump (sso_debug.txt) that our IT grabbed. Can you advise next steps? We're blocked from confirming billing details and the PO is pending.

Thanks,
Emily Ross
Vendor Onboarding, Helion Systems
emily.ross@helionsys.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@helionsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Can't finish supplier setup — keeps asking security question after SSO

Hi Emily — thanks for the details and attachments, that helped.

Quick summary of what I see from our side: the redirect from your IdP into the Coupa onboarding flow is completing, but our session cookie store sees a mismatch between the post-auth state and the profile claim (org_id) in the token. The portal then falls back to the security question flow as a second-factor confirmation, but the client-side state machine isn't advancing because the POST to /onboard/confirm returns a 409 with an internal "duplicate-session" hint.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether your SSO sends an email claim and an alternative org_id claim? (sso_debug.txt helps but if you can paste the SAML attribute map that would be ideal)
- Are you able to try the same link from a different machine on your network (we want to rule out proxied caching)?

Workaround: I'll generate a one-time magic accept link that skips the security question and binds the org_id on our side. Ben (cc'd) is on standby to escalate if the link fails.

I'll follow up with the magic link in ~20 minutes.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

- organization_id: HEL-9012

- groups: Vendors / Hardware

Tried the link from a different laptop on the corporate network and from my phone on cellular — same loop. Adding Ben to this thread is fine.

—Emily

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@helionsys.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Can't finish supplier setup — keeps asking security question after SSO

Emily, Diego — hi. I reviewed the sso_debug.txt and reproduced a similar sequence in our staging tenant. Two notes:
1) The 409 duplicate-session arises when two concurrent onboarding sessions are created (one by the SSO redirect, one by a preflight XHR on the page) and our session token binding rejects the second. This shows up frequently when a load balancer rewrites the relay state twice.
2) The immediate remediation is the magic accept link Diego mentioned. If that is refused, we can ask Helion to whitelist our redirect domain and temporarily disable a short-lived preflight that triggers the second session creation.

Diego — please send the magic link and include the short expiration (30 minutes) and a note for Helion IT to avoid clicking the original onboarding link while we test.

Emily — I'll open an Ops ticket (JIRA-OPS-1842) to track this and include the debug bundle.

-Ben

Diego
